method.name: Configure
method.description: Configures a driver with its specific configuration data.

method.name: GetName
method.description: returns the name identifier of the driver

method.name: GetType
method.description: returns the type identifier of the driver

method.name: GetVersion
method.description: returns the version identifiers of the driver

method.name: QueryParameters
method.description: Updates the driver parameters in the driver environment. Should only be called in the driver thread.

method.name: QueryParametersEx
method.description: Updates the driver parameters in the driver environment. Might be called out of thread. Implementation MUST be able to handle parallel calls.

class.name: SensorthermPyrometer
class.description: A connection to a Sensortherm H4 series pyrometer

method.name: Disconnect
method.description: Disconnects the pyrometer connection. No further call can be handled after.

method.name: GetIdentifier
method.description: Returns the connection identifier.

method.name: GetIPAddress
method.description: Returns the IP address of the pyrometer.

method.name: GetCommandPort
method.description: Returns the TCP port the pyrometer commands are sent to.

method.name: GetStreamPort
method.description: Returns the TCP port the pyrometer streams its measurement data to.

param.name: Port
param.description: Data stream port of the pyrometer.

method.name: IsConnected
method.description: Checks if the pyrometer connection is alive.

param.name: Connected
param.description: True, if the pyrometer is connected.

method.name: SendCommand
method.description: Sends a raw command to the pyrometer. The device address is automatically prefixed, and the carriage return terminator is added by the driver.

param.name: Command
param.description: Command string to send, without device address and without terminator.

param.name: Response
param.description: Answer of the pyrometer, without the carriage return terminator. Empty for write only commands.

method.name: PollSample
method.description: Actively requests one measurement packet from the pyrometer over the command connection (buffer poll). Returns true if a valid sample was received.

param.name: Received
param.description: True, if a measurement sample could be received.

method.name: UpdateStream
method.description: Reads all pending packets from the data stream connection and keeps the newest sample. Does not block longer than the configured timeout.

param.name: Received
param.description: True, if at least one new packet could be read.

method.name: StartStreaming
method.description: Selects the configured stream mode on the device and starts the IP data stream.

method.name: StopStreaming
method.description: Stops the IP data stream of the pyrometer.

method.name: IsStreaming
method.description: Checks if the IP data stream is currently active.

param.name: Streaming
param.description: True, if the data stream is active.

method.name: GetStreamMode
method.description: Returns the stream mode used when starting the data stream.

method.name: SetStreamMode
method.description: Sets the stream mode used when starting the data stream.

method.name: GetTwoColorTemperature
method.description: Returns the two color (quotient) temperature of the latest sample in degree Celsius.

param.name: Temperature
param.description: Two color temperature in degree Celsius.

method.name: GetChannel1Temperature
method.description: Returns the temperature of channel 1 of the latest sample in degree Celsius.

method.name: GetChannel2Temperature
method.description: Returns the temperature of channel 2 of the latest sample in degree Celsius.

method.name: GetSignalStrength
method.description: Returns the signal strength of the latest sample in percent.

method.name: GetControlOutput
method.description: Returns the manipulated variable of the integrated controller of the latest sample in percent.

method.name: GetSetpoint
method.description: Returns the controller setpoint of the latest sample in degree Celsius.

method.name: GetSampleCount
method.description: Returns the number of measurement samples received since the connection was opened.

method.name: GetDeviceTimeStamp
method.description: Returns the device time stamp of the latest sample in milliseconds. The device time stamp wraps around after about 34 seconds.

param.name: DeviceTimeStamp
param.description: Device time stamp of the latest sample in milliseconds.

method.name: GetAgeInMilliseconds
method.description: Returns the age of the latest sample in milliseconds, measured on the machine host.

param.name: Age
param.description: Age of the latest sample in milliseconds, or -1 if no sample was received yet.

method.name: GetDigitalInput
method.description: Returns the state of a digital input of the latest sample.

method.name: GetDigitalOutput
method.description: Returns the state of a digital output of the latest sample.

method.name: IsControlActive
method.description: Returns true if the integrated controller is active in the latest sample.

param.name: ControlActive
param.description: True, if the controller is active.

method.name: IsFahrenheit
method.description: Returns true if the pyrometer reports its temperatures in Fahrenheit.

param.name: Fahrenheit
param.description: True, if the device is configured for Fahrenheit.

method.name: GetFaultStatus
method.description: Reads the fault status of the pyrometer (fs command).

method.name: GetSerialNumber
method.description: Reads the serial number of the pyrometer (sn command).

method.name: GetOrderNumber
method.description: Reads the order number of the pyrometer (bn command).

method.name: GetDeviceType
method.description: Reads the device type string of the pyrometer (ty command).

method.name: GetEmissivity
method.description: Reads the emissivity of the pyrometer in percent (eg command).

method.name: SetEmissivity
method.description: Sets the emissivity of the pyrometer in percent (eg command).

class.name: Driver_Sensortherm
class.description: A Driver for Sensortherm H4 series pyrometers.

method.name: Connect
method.description: Creates a connection to a Sensortherm pyrometer. The sockets are opened lazily, the first command triggers the connection.

param.name: Identifier
param.description: Identifier for the connection. Fails if identifier is already existing.

param.name: CommandPort
param.description: TCP command port of the pyrometer (device default: 1024).

param.name: StreamPort
param.description: TCP data stream port of the pyrometer (device default: 1025).

param.name: DeviceAddress
param.description: Two digit device address of the pyrometer ('00' unless the device was reassigned).

param.name: TimeOutInMs
param.description: Timeout for command responses and stream reads in milliseconds.

method.name: FindConnection
method.description: Finds a connection. Fails if the connection does not exist.

method.name: ConnectionExists
method.description: Checks if a connection exists with a certain identifier.

param.name: Exists
param.description: Returns true, if the connection exists, false otherwise.

method.name: CloseAllConnections
method.description: Closes all connections.

method.name: GetVersion
method.description: retrieves the binary version of this library.

param.name: Major
param.description: returns the major version of this library

param.name: Minor
param.description: returns the minor version of this library

param.name: Micro
param.description: returns the micro version of this library

method.name: GetLastError
method.description: Returns the last error recorded on this object

param.name: HasError
param.description: Is there a last error to query

method.name: ReleaseInstance
method.description: Releases shared ownership of an Instance

method.name: AcquireInstance
method.description: Acquires shared ownership of an Instance

method.name: InjectComponent
method.description: Injects an imported component for usage within this component

param.name: SymbolAddressMethod
param.description: Address of the SymbolAddressMethod of the injected component

method.name: GetSymbolLookupMethod
method.description: Returns the address of the SymbolLookupMethod

method.name: CreateDriver
method.description: Creates a driver instance with a specific name.

param.name: Name
param.description: Name of driver to be created.

param.name: Type
param.description: Type of driver to be created.
